english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or organization you are competing against.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for someone you face or compete against, including an election rival.
This is the all-purpose choice for a person, team, or organisation competing with another, including someone regarded as an equal; it also appears in phrases such as 冇對手 for “has no rival”.
This is the all-purpose choice for an opponent or rival in a contest, conflict, or general opposition.
Use this when the equal is a rival or competitor rather than merely someone of equal status.
Use this for someone you compete or fight against.

examples.english: Our team finally beat that formidable competitor this year.
examples.traditional: 我哋隊今年終於擊敗咗嗰個勁對手。

examples.english: Our opponent in this match is very strong.
examples.traditional: 今場比賽我哋嘅對手實力好強。

examples.english: A team this strong is truly our rival.
examples.traditional: 呢隊波實力咁勁，真係我哋嘅對手。

examples.english: We need to be careful in this match because the adversary is very strong in attack.

examples.english: That team is our equal on the pitch, so the match was tough.
examples.traditional: 嗰隊係我哋場上嘅對手，實力唔相伯仲。

examples.english: Our opponent in this match is last year's champion, the opposite of a pushover.
